title: AI Tooling & Interfaces
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools, integrations, and interfaces for AI agents, enabling interaction with external services, durable execution, user interfaces, and direct model access.

nodes.label: Common Tools & Extensions
nodes.title: Common Tools & Extensions
nodes.description: Provides a collection of pre-built tools and integrations with external services (e.g., search, LangChain) and native agent capabilities (e.g., code execution, memory).

nodes.label: Durable Execution Integrations
nodes.title: Durable Execution Integrations
nodes.description: Integrates AI agents and toolsets with durable execution frameworks like DBOS, Prefect, and Temporal, ensuring reliable and fault-tolerant operations.

nodes.label: Multi-Component Platform (MCP)
nodes.title: Multi-Component Platform (MCP)
nodes.description: Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for serving AI models, loading toolsets from configurations, and defining structured resources for AI interactions.

nodes.label: User Interface Integrations
nodes.title: User Interface Integrations
nodes.description: Provides adapters and endpoints for connecting AI agents with various user interfaces, handling request/response transformations and streaming events (e.g., AG-UI, Vercel AI SDK).

nodes.label: Direct Model Access
nodes.title: Direct Model Access
nodes.description: Offers synchronous functions for direct, non-streamed and streamed requests to AI models, abstracting away asynchronous complexities for simpler interaction.

nodes.label: AI Core Framework
nodes.title: AI Core Framework
nodes.description: The foundational components for building and operating AI agents, including core agent definitions, model providers, and extensible capabilities.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External Integrations
groups.description: Modules for integrating with external services, frameworks, and the Model Context Protocol to extend agent functionality.

groups.label: Execution & UI Layers
groups.title: Execution & UI Layers
groups.description: Components enabling reliable, durable execution of agents, providing user interface connectivity, and offering direct access to AI models.

groups.label: Core AI Foundation
groups.title: Core AI Foundation
groups.description: The underlying framework providing agent orchestration, model providers, and core capabilities that these modules build upon.
